program_name: Doctor of Philosophy in Business Administration
duration: Full-time – Minimum : 3 years, Maximum : 5 years | Part-time – Minimum : 4 years, Maximum: 6 years

fees.notes: QIU does not publish programme fees on its own website; its programme pages state fees/funding are by enquiry (https://qiu.edu.my/programmes/, checked 2026-09-18). Third-party enrolment platform Uni Enrol lists the international total fee for this programme as USD 17,725.81 over 3 years (USD 5,908.60/year). Source: https://unienrol.com/study-malaysia/quest-international-university-qiu/44661-phd-in-business-administration-by-research (accessed 2026-09-18).
